bio: KCC stands for Kulm Country Club. The handsome L-shaped building is located right next to the ice rink and has a garden for summer days. Local produce takes centre stage in the dishes, which often draw on Mediterranean influences. As well as an appealing selection of starters and pasta dishes, the menu includes dishes for two, such as beef cutlets and lamb shoulder. Much of the food is flame-grilled or roasted over embers. The atmosphere is relaxed and the decor tasteful – the vintage sledges adorning the ceiling are bound to draw the eye! There is also a fabulous terrace. Live music and vinyl sessions provide the acoustic backdrop....
